archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-relocation
archetypes.rationale: Late-step prompt authority moved across SKILL and reference files.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed SKILL and reference files for move-not-copy fidelity. Focus on whether required entry reads appear before the correct fences, whether moved bodies have a single normative owner, and whether marker bindings and anti-halt transitions remain inline. Check that structure harness pins cover the new authority split without adding a normal-path /implement Step 5 entry read. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
